venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV beat target +11.9% ($7,622 vs $6,809)** on a gorgeous Thursday — second consecutive +target day this week (after Wed +13.4%). Food $1,052 + Bev $6,370 = $7,622. 194 guests (Sevenrooms) / $39.29 computed GCA (form-stated $39). Comps $344 (investors + members + more gifts & service recovery than normal). **Strong from 6pm open through close to 1am** — surpassed target by 11pm by almost a grand. **EV form 'Total EOD' field was correctly entered this time** ($7,622 = food + bev) — improvement after yesterday's data-integrity flag. **Two large parties** were both very understanding of service level and had an amazing time. **Service shape**: kicked off strong at 6pm and stayed strong; controlled chaos; team flipped tables and seats swiftly to maximize revenue. **Door (Marielle Thoma)**: first turn was 'obscene Tetris' with 91 covers off resys (more than most weekends) — limited maneuvering. Hit a flowstate after. Robust room from 7:30pm with significant waitlist for almost all of service. Cultivated outside vibe to keep waitlist patient. 'Whimsical, vivacious older people' (70-year-old with 6 family members, engagement + birthday combos) plus 'insane NYU grads.' Seated 4-tops at the bar, jammed standing room — 'evil seating' to keep room full 6 hours straight. **Crew**: Thomas on door + James serving — back-catalog goodness; controlled chaos. **Kitchen**: low ramekins (on order). **Glassware breakage**: 1 DOF, 3 SOF, 2 sidecar tops, 1 sidecar bottom, 3 Fizz, 1 Highball (heavy night). **Menu count**: 19. **Maintenance carryover**: bar stools wobbling + portal/door/AC backlog still pending. No incidents, no no-show charges. MOD & Chef: Cara + Steves. Entered by Marielle.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA beat target +34.6% ($7,801 vs $5,796)** on event night + theatrics. Marquee $5,596 (food $1,143) + Event $2,205 + SR $0. Total Food $1,924 (24.7% mix). Comps $384 (investor discount, DNLs, Josh's bday). 149 guests / **$52.35 GCA**. **Event (member Chris Adams' birthday in SR)**: ~40 guests + a burlesque dancer (Ginger, who works at Jumbo's) — 'a fun night of theatrics and shenanigans.' Member Chris had nothing but amazing things to say about the team — shoutout to Mikey and Mitchell for going above and beyond. Closed out $1K to Chris's House Account, remainder to CC. **Marquee (Julian and Bailey)**: tame and manageable, small pops later; not many large parties (room felt skewed). Down 1 bartender — some longer ticket times, but nothing the team couldn't handle. **Midnight**: rang in Josh's bday — 'fun night of laughs and running around.' **Event prep ahead**: another event tomorrow evening. **Kitchen**: handful of event guests ordered a la carte; sold out of oysters from the get-go (Chris's party pre-ordered all of them); lots of fries, chicken, and seafood. **Maintenance — LA SMELL RETURNED (CARRYOVER)**: 'smell was getting pretty gnarly tonight.' After 3+ days of no mention, the smell issue is back. **Action needed**: surface to whoever owns this — appears unresolved despite earlier quiet period. **Favorite moments**: accidentally hotboxing the SR with a sage stick left lit too long; Zak high-fiving a guest; cueing music for the burlesque performer with Jaz on the headset. No incidents. No-shows charged. MOD & Chef: Gigi & Selenia/Josh. Entered by Gigi.

Food $532 (10.6% mix). Comps $364 ('big manager comp'). Voids $88. **DC has multiple events happening this week** — saw a lot more foot traffic than expected. By the time Cory got in, a wait list was already building; inside stayed consistently sat until ~11pm. **OPERATIONAL FLAG — INCIDENT AT TABLE 41 (NEW, 5/14)**: 'we had an incident at table 41 and we noted it in the management channel.' **Action**: review #dc management channel for details and follow-up. **Staffing flag**: Sasha was under the weather, tried to tough it out, but was sent home around 9pm; Cory hopped behind the bar to fill in. **Kitchen**: over 10% in food sales; **86 tartare and cheese plate**. Heavy prep list going into tomorrow and Saturday, but with tomorrow's buyout doing bar snacks only, ample time to prep for Saturday. Note: 'kitchen could use a bit more attention while sweeping.' **What can be better**: bathroom checks, tighter turn communication, table/bar transfers. **Highlight**: lots of old and familiar faces tonight. **Maintenance**: bathrooms, water heaters. **Carryover** from 5/13: classics menu + beer/wine menu still need updating. **Note**: DC 5/12 typeform remains unsubmitted (carryover — Mariah's floor EON only). No-shows charged. MOD: Kevin / Josh / Cory. Entered by Cory.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Sunny a tad windy but perfect
venues.narrative: **MG beat target +27.6% ($8,292 vs $6,500) — first +target day of the week**, ending the 3-day soft streak. Segments: MB Morning $1,117, MB Evening $4,983, Sun Club $694, Hot Eye $1,322, Events $0. Food $3,107 (37.5% mix — strong food share continues, slightly down from yesterday's 41.5%). Comps $420. 159 guests (33 AM + 126 PM via OpenTable) / $52.15 computed GCA. **Morning (MOD Justin & Chef Lex)**: business right at open, then quiet and steady; picked up by 11am, both servers had a few tables each by noon; chill rest of brunch after the 1:15pm food tour. **Evening (MOD Justin & Chef Sukru/Marcus)**: started with 30 covers (mostly first half), cut to 3 servers; busy pace with walk-ins; busiest at 6:30pm and 8:00pm; floor died out around 9:30pm but bar was half-full until 8:30 rush filled it through 10pm. **Sun Club (Nicki)**: $694 — mostly hotel guests despite the nice weather warranting walk-ins; busiest 3–4:30pm. **INCIDENT (NEW, MG Sun Club, no-injury)**: one umbrella tipped over from a strong wind gust despite a sandbag — the sandbag failed and split open. No one injured; first time a sandbag has failed. **Action**: review umbrella anchoring protocol / sandbag inventory. **Hot Eye**: $1,322 — quiet start with post-dinner hotel guests; investors Reg and Josh (friends of Ryan) came through twice and were 'a pleasure'; by 11pm filled with rowdy groups that took the volume uncomfortably high for some regulars/locals; ladies in municipal robes came down for drinks; normal service-industry pop at midnight. **VIP context (from #mg_vip)**: investor Reg sat at table 41 with Matthew Douzuk (VP Operations, Sage Hospitality Group — Perry Lane owners). **Kitchen**: Sorbet and Affogato back on menu (sourced product); Gelato still out. Smooth service. **Highlights**: Kaylee in with family for a late Mother's Day dinner; mocktail success (custom ingredients tasted great); regular Sha'Kobe trying new cocktail menu. No injury/incident other than the umbrella note. Entered by Alexis. **Note**: form's 'Day of Week' said 'Thursday' but Today's Date '2026-05-14' — correct. Yesterday's form had off-by-one date issue (resolved tonight).
